description: The b1 proof-bundle corpus (Bundle §13): one directory per case, each with bundle.json, inputs.json, expected-report.json and expected-exit. README.md states the formats and how to replay a case.
source: Generated by scripts/generate-bundle-b1-corpus.ts from one run of @tzun/sdk: Tzun.init({ mode: 'local', logNamespace: 'test.bundle-b1.tzun', anchoring, attestation }) on anvil (ghcr.io/foundry-rs/foundry:v1.5.1, chain id 31337, finalized = head - 2), publishing from anvil's development account 5, its clock 3600 s behind the wall clock, with a local RFC 3161 authority under a throwaway CA whose tokens meet Anchor §10.5 (DER, a signingCertificateV2, a critical timestamping-only extendedKeyUsage). The expected reports are stated from Verification, Bundle and Anchor §10; the script stopped unless verifyBundle() agreed with every one.

cases.name: anchored-with-newer
cases.description: A record anchored in epoch 1 whose log and anchor log grew in epoch 2: its own anchor, the newer anchor and both consistency proofs hold with the manifest, a header source and the TSA root (Bundle §7.5, §7.6; Anchor §10.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: anchored-offline
cases.description: The same bundle verified with no trust inputs: every publication, the timestamp's trust and both consistency checks are not checked. Exit 4 (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: anchored-offline-allow-unchecked
cases.description: The same, with --allow-unchecked: exit 0, every NOT CHECKED line still in the report (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: anchored-no-header-source
cases.description: The manifest and the TSA root, no header source: the transaction's offline facts hold and never make the publication true (tzun-anchor/1 §10.4). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchored-not-final
cases.description: A header source whose finalized height is below both publications' blocks: evm_block_not_finalized, with the finality it judged by (tzun-anchor/1 §10.4 items 10 and 14). Exit 4.

cases.name: timestamp-untrusted
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token verifies, and chains to no root the auditor supplied: ts.record.trust not checked, no_matching_trust_anchor (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4). Exit 4.

cases.name: record-token-not-der
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token with its TSTInfo in a constructed (BER) OCTET STRING, which decodes to the same bytes and is not DER: ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token, and ts.record.trust blocked by it (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-no-signing-certificate
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token, validly signed, whose signed attributes carry neither a signingCertificate nor a signingCertificateV2, so nothing binds its signer certificate: ts.record.token checked-wrong, verification_failed (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 3). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-no-timestamping-eku
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate of the same name under the root the auditor supplied, with no extendedKeyUsage: not a timestamping certificate, so ts.record.token checked-wrong, verification_failed, whatever root it chains to (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 3). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-digest-algorithms-malformed
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token, validly signed, whose SignedData.digestAlgorithms holds a bare OBJECT IDENTIFIER where a SET OF AlgorithmIdentifier belongs. The set is not signed, so anyone can change it: ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-unreadable-certificate
cases.description: The record's genuine RFC 3161 token with one certificate added to its unsigned certificates set: a CA certificate of the root's name whose public key is not a point on its curve. A certificate whose key does not decode is not a certificate, so ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token, and every other check is still reported (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 1; Verification §4.4). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-signer-off-curve
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose P-256 point is not on the curve: a curve every verifier implements, so the certificate is not one: ts.record.token checked-wrong, malformed_token (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 1). Exit 1.

cases.name: record-token-signer-unassigned-curve
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token whose signer certificate names the curve OID 1.2.840.10045.3.1.99, assigned to no curve: its key is left unread, not a decoding failure, and step 3 needs it: ts.record.token not checked, missing_dependency, and ts.record.trust blocked by it (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 steps 1 and 5). Exit 4.

cases.name: record-token-intermediate-unassigned-curve
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate that an intermediate CA issued, the intermediate carried in the token with its key renamed to the curve OID 1.2.840.10045.3.1.99 and signed again by the supplied root: every rule of the path holds but the intermediate's signature over the signer, which no verifier can check. ts.record.token checked-correct, ts.record.trust not checked, missing_dependency (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 5). Exit 4.

cases.name: record-token-unneeded-certificate-unassigned-curve
cases.description: The record's genuine RFC 3161 token with a certificate added that no path names, whose key names the curve OID 1.2.840.10045.3.1.99: no step needs its key, so it is not examined past step 1, and every check holds (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 steps 1 and 5). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-first-cn
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is two commonName RDNs after a country: the first: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "First CN" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-multi-valued-rdn
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a commonName inside a multi-valued RDN with an organization: its value alone: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "Multi CN" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-specials
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a commonName with RFC 4514 specials and a space at each end: as encoded, with no escaping and no trimming: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority " Acme, Inc. + \"TSA\" = #1 \\ <x>; " (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-line-feed
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a commonName holding a line feed: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "Line1\nLine2" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-utf8-string
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a UTF8String commonName outside ASCII: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "Zeitstempel Zürich Ω 時" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-bmp-string
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a BMPString commonName, read as UTF-16: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "Zürich BMP" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-teletex-string
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a TeletexString commonName with the byte 0xFC, read as ISO 8859-1: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "Zürich T61" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-empty-cn
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is an empty commonName after an organization: the empty string: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-no-cn
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a subject with no commonName: the empty string: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-authority-empty-subject
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate whose subject is a subject with no RDN: the empty string: ts.record.trust checked-correct with authority "" (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4, §10.7). Exit 0.

cases.name: record-token-issuer-name-reencoded
cases.description: The record's RFC 3161 token signed by a certificate the supplied root did issue, whose issuer name writes the root's CN as a UTF8String where the root's subject writes a PrintableString. Names match byte for byte, so no path reaches the root: ts.record.token checked-correct, ts.record.trust not checked, no_matching_trust_anchor (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 4). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchor-token-trusted
cases.description: The record's anchor with a second publication: an rfc3161/1 token over its P from a second authority, whose root the auditor supplies beside the record authority's. Steps 1 to 3 hold on anchor.tsa.token[1], and step 4 on anchor.tsa.trust[1], with genTime and authority. The EVM block time is earlier, so existedBy stays the EVM publication's (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5, §10.6). Exit 0.

cases.name: anchor-token-no-roots
cases.description: The same bundle with no RFC 3161 root supplied: steps 1 to 3 need none, so anchor.tsa.token[1] holds; no path reaches a supplied root, so anchor.tsa.trust[1] is not checked, no_matching_trust_anchor, and the publication is null. The anchor holds by its EVM publication (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchor-token-other-value
cases.description: The second authority's token over the record's digest instead of the anchor's P, its root supplied: anchor.tsa.token[1] checked-wrong, imprint_mismatch, anchor.tsa.trust[1] blocked by it, whatever root the token chains to. One false publication makes the record's anchor false, with no fact from it; anchor.newer holds (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 2, §10.6). Exit 1.

cases.name: anchor-token-not-der
cases.description: The second authority's token over the anchor's P with its TSTInfo in a constructed (BER) OCTET STRING, which is not DER: anchor.tsa.token[1] checked-wrong, malformed_publication, anchor.tsa.trust[1] blocked by it, and the record's anchor false (tzun-anchor/1 §10.5 step 1, §10.6). Exit 1.

cases.name: anchored-latest-epoch
cases.description: A record anchored in the newest epoch: one checkpoint per log, no newer anchor and no consistency check (Bundle §7.3). Exit 0.

cases.name: unanchored-awaiting-epoch
cases.description: A record no epoch has taken yet: anchorPending, never a marker in nonRepudiation; anchor absent and anchor.pending not checked, not_yet_published (Bundle §7.7). Exit 4.

cases.name: unanchored-allow-unchecked
cases.description: The same, with --allow-unchecked: exit 0 (Bundle §7.7).

cases.name: unanchored-awaiting-finality
cases.description: The same record exported after its epoch's transaction was mined and before it was final: still pending (Bundle §2, §7.7). Exit 4.

cases.name: tampered-payload
cases.description: A payload edited under its stored digest: record.digest checked-wrong once, and everything that takes the digest as input blocked by it (Verification §2.2, §4.3). Exit 1.

cases.name: payload-name-lone-surrogate-fffd-digest
cases.description: A payload whose hashed aiOutput holds a member named "\ud800", a lone surrogate, under a stored digest computed with U+FFFD in its place: the canonical serialization refuses the name, never normalises it, so record.digest is checked-wrong, payload_unserializable, and everything that takes the digest as input is blocked by it (Record §3.6, Verification §4.3). Exit 1.

cases.name: envelope-version-unknown
cases.description: An envelope tagged e2, a version this verifier does not read: record.digest abstains, unsupported_envelope_version, and everything that takes the digest as input is blocked by it (Verification §2.2: an unknown tag abstains on its section). Exit 4, never a pass.

cases.name: rewrite-and-reseat
cases.description: A payload rewritten with its digest and chain link recomputed: the record reads intact, and its RFC 3161 token and both anchors are over another digest (imprint_mismatch, merkle_proof_invalid). Exit 1.

cases.name: transplanted-leaf
cases.description: Another record's artifact, from the same chain, on this record: leaf_index_mismatch; the store's material still anchors the record (anchor.newer). Exit 1.

cases.name: transplanted-chain
cases.description: An artifact from a record on another chain of the store: chain_id_mismatch (tzun-anchor/1 §10.3 step 2b). Exit 1.

cases.name: tampered-log-path
cases.description: One hash of the record's path in its log flipped: merkle_proof_invalid. Exit 1.

cases.name: tampered-anchor-path
cases.description: One hash of the log checkpoint's path in the anchor log flipped: anchor_proof_invalid. Exit 1.

cases.name: fabricated-header-offline
cases.description: A validly signed transaction under a self-consistent, back-dated header (its hash written into the envelope and the bundle), with no header source: anchor.evm.tx holds, anchor.evm.canonical is not checked, the publication is null, and no existedBy comes from it (Anchor §10.4, §10.6). Exit 4.

cases.name: fabricated-header-with-source
cases.description: The same bundle against the auditor's header source: the block at that height has another hash, anchor_not_found_on_chain. Exit 1.

cases.name: manifest-chain-mismatch
cases.description: The manifest names the publisher on another chain than the one the transaction signed: evm_chain_mismatch (Anchor §10.4). Exit 1.

cases.name: sender-not-publisher
cases.description: The manifest names another address for the anchor origin: evm_sender_mismatch. Exit 1.

cases.name: manifest-valid-from-fraction-late
cases.description: The manifest's entry for the publisher has a validFrom half a millisecond past the second of the newer publication's block. Compared at full precision (Anchor §9), the window opens after both publications' blocks: evm_sender_mismatch. A reader that keeps milliseconds reads .0005 as .000 and admits them. Exit 1.

cases.name: manifest-valid-from-fraction-early
cases.description: The same entry with a validFrom half a millisecond into the second before the record's publication's block: the window opens before both blocks, and the bundle verifies as anchored-with-newer does (tzun-anchor/1 §9). Exit 0.

cases.name: forged-future-anchor-spec
cases.description: The record's artifact relabelled tzun-anchor/2: the verifier abstains on that section, which is never a pass. Exit 4 (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: consistency-proof-tampered
cases.description: One hash of the anchor log's consistency proof flipped, between two authenticated checkpoints: log_inconsistent_with_anchor (tzun-anchor/1 §10.8). Exit 1.

cases.name: consistency-proof-missing
cases.description: The evidence log's consistency proof left out: not_in_bundle:consistency_proof. Exit 4.

cases.name: newer-anchor-tampered
cases.description: One hash of the newer checkpoint's path in the newest anchor checkpoint flipped: anchor.newer anchor_proof_invalid, and the consistency it would authenticate blocked by it. Exit 1.

cases.name: split-view
cases.description: A second history of the record's log at the same size, taken into an extension of the anchor log and published with the store's own key: every anchor holds, and the two authenticated bodies of one size differ: split_view (tzun-anchor/1 §10.8). Exit 1.

cases.name: subject-mismatch
cases.description: A subject that does not name the envelope's digest (Bundle §5.1). Exit 1.

cases.name: witness-extension
cases.description: A value in the reserved witness/1 extension: this verifier abstains on that key only (Bundle §9). Exit 4.

cases.name: anchored-log-unchanged
cases.description: A record on another chain of the store, anchored in epoch 1, whose log did not grow while the anchor log did: one checkpoint of its log, carrying its anchor into the newest anchor checkpoint, and the anchor log's two checkpoints with their proof (Bundle §7.5; Anchor §10.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: signed-record
cases.description: A record signed at capture: its expectation is null and it carries no sign-off block, so signoff.expectation holds; its WebAuthn assertion needs a credential no slot of b1 carries, signoff.key not_in_bundle:credential (Verification §4.5, §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: signature-stripped
cases.description: A record whose hashed payload.signoffExpectation owes a signature under a sign-off policy ({ policyDigest }), signed at capture, with its WebAuthn assertion removed: a bundle cannot tell a stripped signature from one still to come, so signoff.expectation and signoff.key are not checked, signature_missing, and never absent (Verification §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: session-record
cases.description: A record captured into slot 1 of a sign-off session: { statementDigest, sessionSeq } inside its digest, written with its signoff block and an assertion that presented the session statement's challenge. signoff.expectation holds with no key; signoff.key needs a credential no slot of b1 carries (Record §9.1, Verification §5). Exit 4.

cases.name: session-signoff-stripped
cases.description: The session record with its signoff block and assertion removed: a session record is written with its sign-off (Record §9.1), so the record alone shows the removal, signoff.expectation checked-wrong, signoff_stripped, and signoff.key blocked by it (21 CFR 11.70). Exit 1, with or without --allow-unchecked.

cases.name: session-signoff-transplanted
cases.description: The session record's signoff block and assertion moved onto a record whose hashed expectation is null: signoff.expectation checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected (21 CFR 11.70). The digest does not cover nonRepudiation, so only the expectation shows it. Exit 1.

cases.name: session-signoff-without-assertion
cases.description: A record whose hashed expectation is null, carrying the session record's signoff block and no assertion: a session sign-off is the block alone, so signoff.expectation is checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected, and signoff.key blocked by it (Record §9.3, Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: policy-session-signoff-without-assertion
cases.description: A record whose hashed expectation is { policyDigest }, its assertion removed, carrying the session record's signoff block: the session rule comes before the one that reads a missing assertion as signature_missing, so signoff.expectation is checked-wrong, session_signoff_not_expected, and signoff.key blocked by it (Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: junk-batch-signoff
cases.description: The signed record with a batch signoff block beside its per-record assertion, whose statement has no digest, no root and no inclusion proof: a sign-off block that does not bind by the checks that need no key is never a signature carried, signoff.expectation checked-wrong, signoff_unbound (Record §9.5, Verification §5). Exit 1.

cases.name: contributions-single-model
cases.description: A human's decision on one model call: a contributions list of one, its step's actor null and its output the record's aiOutput. contributions and contributions.binding hold (Record §7.3, §7.5). Exit 0.

cases.name: contributions-decided-output-differs
cases.description: A decision whose aiOutput is not the output its one proposal recorded: capture accepts a flawed process, and contributions.binding reports it from the record alone, decided_output_differs (Record §7.5, Verification §4.10). Exit 1.

cases.name: links-derived-from
cases.description: A decision deriving from b1 in the same store: a derivedFrom link and the root link the builder adds, both naming b1 with its locator. A bundle holds no target, and no edge is proven in this version, so each edge row abstains, unsupported_link_edge (Record §8.8, Verification §4.11). Exit 4.

cases.name: links-derived-from-allow-unchecked
cases.description: The same under --allow-unchecked: exit 0, every abstaining row still in the report.

cases.name: links-derived-from-allow-unchecked-scoped
cases.description: The same under the scoped allowance --allow-unchecked unsupported_link_edge (regime allowUnchecked ["unsupported_link_edge"]): only rows abstaining for that reason stop counting toward 4, and here they are the only ones. Exit 0.

cases.name: decider-agent
cases.description: An agent's own decision, its decider named by the digest of a descriptor registered in the store's catalog: decider holds, agent-asserted (Record §6, Verification §4.9). Exit 0.

cases.name: custody-ledger
cases.description: A record with a custody row an operator recorded after capture, and the envelope's hashed mirror of it: this version verifies no custody material, so custody.ledger abstains, unsupported_artifact, and never vouches for the row (Verification §4.3, Bundle §6). Exit 4.

cases.name: custody-row-removed
cases.description: The same bundle with its custody row left out: the envelope's hashed mirror names a row the ledger does not hold, mirror_entry_unexpected. Exit 1.

cases.name: custody-row-and-mirror-removed
cases.description: The row and its hashed mirror entry both left out: the slot holds no row and the envelope names none, so custody.ledger is not_applicable. Nothing in the bundle commits to the ledger, so a row removed with its mirror entry leaves no trace (Verification §4.3). Exit 0.

cases.name: artifact-not-filled
cases.description: An anchored record whose envelope the fill has not reached, as the exporter writes it: no artifact names the record's own checkpoints, so only the newest of each log is carried, with the record's anchor into it; anchor absent, anchor.newer holds (Bundle §7.3, §7.5). Exit 0.

cases.name: artifact-stripped
cases.description: The first bundle with the envelope's artifact removed: the record's own checkpoints are still carried, and nothing authenticates them, so neither consistency check can run (tzun-anchor/1 §10.8). Exit 4.

cases.name: tampered-payload-artifact-stripped
cases.description: The artifact-stripped bundle with its payload edited: record.digest checked-wrong, and with no artifact to wait for the digest the anchor rows are absent, not blocked; anchor.newer, whose composed artifact takes the digest, is blocked by it (Verification §4.3, §4.6; Bundle §7.4). Exit 1.

cases.name: carried-checkpoints-contradict
cases.description: A record anchored in the newest epoch whose carried checkpoints are replaced by bodies of the same logs and sizes with other roots: nothing authenticates them, with one checkpoint per log as with two, so the consistency checks are not checked, blocked_by:anchor.newer (tzun-anchor/1 §10.8). Exit 4.

cases.name: checkpoints-of-two-logs-under-one-key
cases.description: The artifact's evidence-log and anchor-log checkpoints carried together under the evidence log's key: a checkpoint sits under the key of its own origin, so the bundle cannot be read, and two logs are never compared as one (Bundle §7.1). Exit 2.

cases.name: related-records-filled
cases.description: The reserved relatedRecords slot filled: this verifier does not read it yet, so it abstains on it, which is never a pass (Bundle §8). Exit 4.

cases.name: policy-filled
cases.description: The reserved policy slot filled: abstain on it, unsupported_slot (Bundle §8). Exit 4.

cases.name: unknown-member
cases.description: A top-level member a b1 record bundle does not have: abstain on it, unsupported_member, since what it carries is not examined (Bundle §3.3). Exit 4.

cases.name: nonrepudiation-unread-members
cases.description: Members of nonRepudiation no check reads: an assertionTimestamp (ts.assertion.token), a legacy blockchainAnchor beside the anchor (nonRepudiation.blockchainAnchor, legacy_blockchain_anchor) and an unknown member (nonRepudiation.futureArtifact), each abstained on, in byte order of its name, never passed over in silence (Verification §4.7). Exit 4.

cases.name: subject-extra-member
cases.description: A subject with a member beside evidenceId and canonicalDigest: the subject check reads those two and holds, and the report restates the bundle's subject as it stands, the extra member included (Verification §4.2, §6.1). Exit 0.

cases.name: unanchored-pending-stripped
cases.description: An unanchored record's bundle with anchorPending set to null: it reads as a record of a store that does not anchor, since an absent anchor is not an unchecked artifact (Verification §6.6, Bundle §7.8). Exit 0.

cases.name: unanchored-pending-stripped-require-anchor
cases.description: The same under a regime that requires the anchor: exit 3. An auditor who needs the record anchored requires anchor (Verification §6.6).

cases.name: bundle-version-unknown
cases.description: bundleVersion b2: the verifier abstains on the whole bundle (Bundle §4). Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-version-absent
cases.description: No bundleVersion: read as unknown, abstained on (Bundle §4). Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-chain-profile
cases.description: The chain profile, which this verifier does not implement: abstain on the whole bundle. Exit 2.

cases.name: bundle-unreadable
cases.description: A bundle with no envelope: it cannot be read. Exit 2.

cases.name: member-name-lone-surrogate
cases.description: A top-level member named "\ud800", a lone UTF-16 surrogate, a name a member[…] row id would carry: malformed_bundle, the only row (Bundle §4 step 9). Exit 2.

cases.name: extension-name-lone-surrogate
cases.description: An extensions member named "\ud800", a name an extension[…] row id would carry: malformed_bundle, the only row (Bundle §4 step 9). Exit 2.

cases.name: nonrepudiation-name-lone-surrogate
cases.description: An envelope.nonRepudiation member named "\ud800", a name a nonRepudiation.… row id would carry: malformed_bundle, the only row (Bundle §4 step 9). Exit 2.
